'''Owen Benjamin''' (born May 24, 1980) is an American comedian and actor known for his controversial views and involvement in various conspiracy theories. Initially gaining recognition through his work in comedy and acting, Benjamin has increasingly attracted attention for his contentious statements and affiliations.

During the 2010s, Benjamin began to publicly share conspiracy theories, which became a significant aspect of his public persona. He gained notoriety for promoting ideas such as flat Earth theory and other alternative explanations contrary to mainstream science and history. His statements have often sparked significant backlash and led to his de-platforming from major social media networks due to violations of community guidelines regarding hate speech and misinformation.

Benjamin has frequently associated with far-right figures and platforms, most notably appearing on "The Alex Jones Show," hosted by Infowars founder Alex Jones. Through these appearances, Benjamin has further propagated controversial viewpoints and conspiracies, aligning himself with Jones' brand of skepticism towards government and media narratives.

His affiliations and statements have led to ongoing controversies, impacting his career in the entertainment industry and leading to a polarized reception from audiences. Despite these controversies, Benjamin maintains a following through alternative media platforms where he continues to share his ideas and beliefs.
